decisions.reason: As a lightly presented component-type innovation tied to the broader gas infrared line, it looks like a tentative option whose value should be abandoned if it has not clearly strengthened the retained heater portfolio by 2022.

Its dedicated product page suggests higher initial commitment and better revealed demand, so it is still worth keeping as one of the more credible gas infrared options despite the weaker 2022 outlook for gas-based heating products.

This niche luminous radiant heater was only lightly promoted and sits in a crowded family of similar gas products, so the option value now appears too limited to justify continued portfolio complexity.
A merely mentioned tube-heater variant with close substitutes in the same launch cohort is a strong candidate for abandonment once uncertainty has had time to resolve and gas-market risk has risen.
Because it had its own page and fills a standard product role, it is more likely than the lightly mentioned variants to have earned a place as a core offering worth keeping open for another year.
This looks like another overlapping tube-heater option with limited distinct commitment, and real-options logic favors pruning such redundant variants after several years of learning.
